paragraphs: Mar Yochani lived in Shmuel’s time. He asked Shmuel, in the chapter Megalchin. Abaye said: ‘Mar Yehudah of the house of Mar Yochani [digital witness: יוחנ כאו׳; name restored contextually] told me,’ and so forth: Avodah Zarah, chapter 1, 16b.
